_meta.name: BOTIA Terminology Glossary
_meta.purpose: Controlled terminology for all BOTIA translations. Any script that translates content MUST check this file first. If a term appears here, copy the value — do not send it to a translation API.

immutable._rule: NEVER translate, adapt, transliterate or modify. Copy exactly as-is in all 14 languages.
immutable._layer_note: flavour is spelled WITH U. The WebView file is ingredients/flavor.html without U — that is the filename, not the layer identifier. Do not unify them.
immutable._institutions_note: Institution acronyms stay in their original form. Their full names MAY be translated in body text, but the acronym never changes.
immutable.e_codes_pattern: Any value matching E followed by digits (E100-E1520), or ranges like E150a-E150d, or INS numbers. Never translate, never transliterate.

interface_labels._rule: Translate, but use exactly these values. Must sound natural and fit the interface.

technical_terms._rule: Established technical terminology. Use the official equivalent in each language, never a literal translation.

halal._note: Transliteration of Arabic حلال. Keep as-is in all Latin/Cyrillic scripts. Use the original Arabic script in ar.

mashbooh._note: Transliteration of Arabic مشبوه. Means doubtful, not forbidden.

ultra-processed._note: NOVA Group 4 terminology. Use the official nutritional term, not a literal translation.

free sugars._note: WHO terminology. Not 'added sugars' — free sugars is a broader, defined category.

false_friends._rule: Words that translation engines get wrong. ALWAYS check context before translating.

soy._problem: In an ingredient name, 'soy' is the legume, NOT the Spanish verb 'ser'. Engines have produced 'Yo soy isoflavonas', 'Io sono isoflavoni', 'Ik ben Isoflavones', 'Ben Isoflavones', 'Я изофлавоны'.
soy._correct: Always translate as the legume: soja, soia, soya, kedelai, 大豆, الصويا

can._problem: In 'BOTIA CAN', 'can' is the modal verb, NOT the container. Engines have produced '博蒂亚罐头' (BOTIA tin can) and 'بوتيا كان' (BOTIA was).

gum._problem: In hydrocolloid names, 'gum' is the plant exudate, NOT chewing gum. And the different gums must not be swapped: tara gum has been rendered as tragacanth and as locust bean gum.
gum._correct: Each gum keeps its own botanical identity. Tara ≠ tragacanth ≠ locust bean ≠ guar ≠ karaya ≠ arabic.

flavour._problem: British and American spelling coexist in the repo. The layer identifier is 'flavour' with U. The WebView filename is 'flavor.html' without U.
flavour._correct: Layer identifier: flavour. Filename: flavor.html. Do not unify.

natural._problem: 'Natural flavouring' is a legal category, not a description. Translating it as 'sabor de la naturaleza' or similar loses the regulatory meaning.
natural._correct: Use the official regulatory term in each language.

translation_rules._rule: Rules any translation script MUST follow.
translation_rules.prompt_language: The translation prompt MUST be written in English. A prompt written in Spanish has caused DeepSeek to return Spanish instead of the target language.
translation_rules.on_failure: If a translation fails after retries, ABORT and report. NEVER return the original text — that has silently propagated Spanish into Italian files.
translation_rules.source_language: Always translate FROM i18n/en/. Never read the target language file as a source.
translation_rules.verification: After translating, compare the result against i18n/es/. If any string over 40 characters is identical, it is contamination — do not write the file. Exclude URLs and aliases from this check.
translation_rules.short_strings: Strings under 5 words are the highest risk. Give the engine context: instead of 'CAN', send 'section heading meaning what BOTIA is able to do'.
